briefing: Markets sold off broadly today, with the NASDAQ down 2.2% and the S&P 500 down 1.7%, so the screener flagged risk-off conditions and returned no buy candidates. We are holding all 7 positions and keeping the $545.88 in cash. The automatic stop-losses (-7%) and profit targets (+12%) will handle exits, so there is no reason to panic-sell good positions on one bad day.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Risk-off means investors are nervous and move money out of riskier assets like growth and tech stocks into safer ones like cash or bonds. When the whole market drops together like it did today, buying new stocks is risky because prices can keep sliding. Waiting for conditions to calm down before adding new positions helps you avoid large losses.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨保守，把資金從成長股、科技股等較高風險的資產撤出，轉投現金或債券等相對穩健的資產。當大市像今日這樣齊齊下跌時，貿然入市建倉容易越買越跌。耐心等待市況回穩才增持，有助避免大幅虧損。

market_education.summary_en: Major US indexes fell sharply today, and tech-heavy stocks led the way down: the NASDAQ lost 2.2% and the S&P 500 lost 1.7%. No news headlines were available in today's data, so we can't name the specific cause. A drop this broad usually means investors are pulling back from risk across the market, often because of worries about interest rates, the economy or high growth-stock valuations, rather than problems at any one company.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面受壓，科技股跌幅較深，納斯達克指數下挫2.2%，標普500指數亦回落1.7%。由於今日資料未有附上新聞標題，暫時無法指出具體觸發因素。這類大範圍下跌通常反映資金普遍轉趨避險，多半源於市場對利率走向、經濟前景或成長股估值偏高的憂慮，而非個別企業出事。
